messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up: BlueCrest wants a short POC next week to validate SSO + SCIM + delegated admin flows before buying Dedicated. They want DNS-based domain claim enforcement, nested groups, and live deprovision tests. Timeline: 10 business days. Who can lead?
Dimitri (SE): I can run the technical side. They
nnounce Azure AD + Okta as IdPs. We support SAML and OIDC; SCIM v2 push from Azure AD is typical. Important: groupPaging and incremental sync are off by default. If they have >5k users/groups enable incremental.
Dimitri (SE): Minimal SCIM example we send:
```http
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "alice@bluecrest.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"W"},
  "emails": [{"value":"alice@bluecrest.com","primary":true}]
}
```
Dimitri (SE): For group -> role mapping we accept `members` arrays and can map group displayName -> redwood_role via mapping config. Nested groups are supported but we flatten on import by default, can retain hierarchy if they want.
Claire (Product): Product note: delegated admin model = tenant_owner, org_admin, support_viewer. tenant_owner can verify domains and change billing; org_admin can manage users/groups and delegated admins up to their scope. We also can limit delegated admin to specific domains.
Jules (Security): From questionnaire: need the following to complete security answers: sample SAML metadata (IdP), SCIM endpoint (staging + prod) and expected request rate, CIDR allowlist for their outbound, audit retention (we default 90d), cert rotation policy, encryption at rest details (customer keys ok), and whether PII will be synced. Also they asked about SCIM auth methods 2b7 we accept OAuth2 Bearer tokens; mutual TLS is available on Dedicated.
Priya (Pricing): Pricing quick: Hosted includes basic SCIM up to 5k sync ops/day. For provisioning heavy customers we add a provisioning add-on (fixed monthly) or per-sync overage. Delegated admin feature included on enterprise tier. Dedicated/private pricing is separate. Need expected MAU and sync ops to produce final quote.
Carlos (Solutions): Proposed POC steps:
1) Staging IdP metadata + test Azure AD tenant (200 users, 4 groups)
2) SCIM push with one-time full sync then incremental changes (add/remove user, change group mapping)
3) Domain verification via DNS TXT for bluecrest.com (we'll provide TXT value)
4) Validate delegated admin can create users in scoped domain only
5) Deliver brief sec pack and quote
Maya (AE): BlueCrest also wants to know if we can restrict domain claims to only verified domains (yes) and whether subdomain wildcard verification is supported for *.bluecrest.com (we support explicit subdomain verification; wildcard needs legal sign-off).
Dimitri (SE): Implementation notes: we check verified domains at authentication time and reject tokens with email domain not verified. For SAML, NameID/email mapping must be configured. We also support custom attribute `redwood_tenant` to ensure tenant scoping.
Jules (Security): I'll prepare the questionnaire answers and a short One-Pager with cert rotation windows and incident response contact. Also ask Legal about EU data residency if they have EU tenants.
Priya (Pricing): Ballpark: Hosted + SCIM for ~8k employees ~ $8k-18k/mo depending on sync frequency and seat license. I'll send a preliminary delta by EOD.
Carlos (Solutions): Runbook I'll prepare: lists of required artifacts, sample SCIM token creation steps, example group mapping CSV, and failure-mode checklist (what to do if SCIM returns 409/429).
Maya (AE): Assignments: Dimitri -> run SCIM tests; Jules -> security pack; Priya -> quote; Carlos -> runbook; Claire -> role mapping confirmation. I'll collect IdP metadata from Roman at BlueCrest. Meeting: Wed 9am PT for initial handshake.
Dimitri (SE): One more note: If they want deprovisioning to also wipe data downstream we can support a deprovision webhook to notify apps; that's an opt-in config.
Claire (Product): Add `email_normalization` and `alias_handling` options to runbook if they use alias addressing.
Maya (AE): Sounds good. I'll send calendar and ask for staging access. :pray:
